Press wk8 58, deadlift wk5 208 and bench wk8 96 weren't done, so this week repeats those workbook rows.
Monday after the Long Hard Night: WL only, C&J + POLP press. The 5:30 class (1.4 km of running) and the deadlift are skipped.
Deadlift moves to Thursday's comp class after bench, in place of the AGQ test: 2 POLP lifts, no bench + press, and two days clear of Saturday's pulls.
Tuesday's class moves to 5:30pm (Josh). Comp extras skipped: muscle-up blocks wait for Block 2.
Row W1 S1 gets a fixed Friday slot. If it misses again, park rowing until after the comp.
HSPU EMOM stays at 8 min × 3s; Wednesday's strict HSPU ladder is an extra touch.

streams.text:
If not able to break up the sessions do a ski instead of the Row.

A. 3 Rounds for time:
1500/1300m Echo Bike
30 Toes to Bar

*25 min time cap

streams.label: Performance PM (5:30pm) — POLP back squat, then WOD
streams.text:
If doing the WOD before WL do Box Jumps (24/20")

A. POLP Back Squat:
*First week 3s x 10r x 65%, add 5% for every successful week. If you fail the 10s twice chat to a coach.

B. 10 min AMRAP:
2-4-6-8-10-etc
Front Squat (60/42.5kg)
Strict Handstand Push Up

- 2 min rest -

1 min max lateral Burpees over the bar

→ Back squat wk10: builds 120 × 5, 136 × 3, then 153 × 3 × 5. Box jumps instead of the burpees (WL follows). Keep the strict HSPUs crisp: stop a set before it grinds.

streams.label: Skill & Strength (5:30pm)
streams.text:
A. Gymnastics Week 19: Accessories:
alt OTM for 3 rounds
M1: 5 DB Lying Pull Overs
M2: 5 no touch shoot throughs
M3: 3 5 sec bottom of Pistol Hold (use pole if needed)
M4: 8 DB External Rotations (left)
M5: 8 DB External Rotations (right)
M6: 3 Seated Single Leg Lifts Holds (5 sec) (e side)

B. 18 min AMRAP:
1-3 Max Freestanding Shoulder tap attempts
*If you don't go above 10 on your first 2 attempts, 3rd attempt go on the wall.
3 Strict Chest to bar Pull Ups (10 secs minimum between each, be explosive)
10 sec Bottom Of Bar Dip Hold (aim for max depth)
15 sec L/Tuck Hold
20 Hollow Rocks

streams.label: Open gym — Row 5K W1 S1 + Spanish squats
streams.text:
Row 5K W1 S1:
5 x 300m, rest 1 min between. 70%, 75%, 80%, 85%, 90% efforts respectively.
+
4 Sets;
Row 4 min @ 5k PR Pace + 2 sec, rest 60 seconds between.
*+2 seconds means +2 seconds slower than your set pace.

Spanish squat holds 3 × 30s

→ 5k PR pace 1:55.9/500m, so the 4-min sets are at 1:57.9. Go by pace, not HR. Spanish holds are for the knee.

streams.label: Open gym — HSPU EMOM + MU drills, then Row S2
streams.text:
HSPU EMOM: 8 min × 3 strict HSPU
+ ~10 min ring MU drills (kip swings, false-grip kip to hips, low-ring transitions)

Row 5K W1 S2:
Row 30 min @ Z1 building to Z3 through the 30 min.

→ Move up only if every minute is crisp; cut the EMOM short if a rep slows. Row: start under 128 bpm, finish 145–152.
